query: My Galaxy S23 battery drops from 100 percent to about 40 percent overnight even though I don't touch the phone while I sleep.

siis_response.title: Battery drains overnight on a Samsung phone or tablet
siis_response.content:
Smartphone,Tablet Battery drains overnight on a Samsung phone or tablet ( Smartphone,Tablet): # Battery Drains Overnight on Your Galaxy Device
A large overnight drop usually means an app or a connection stayed active while the screen was off. Work through the checks below in order.
## Step 1: Review Which Apps Used the Battery
Open Settings and tap Battery. Review the usage list for the last twenty four hours. An app near the top of the list that you did not open overnight is the most likely cause.
## Step 2: Put Unused Apps to Sleep
In Settings, tap Battery, then tap Background usage limits. Add the app you identified to the Deep sleeping apps list so that it cannot run while the screen is off.
## Step 3: Turn On Power Saving Mode
Open Settings, tap Battery, and then turn on Power saving. Power saving mode limits background activity and reduces the processor speed while you are asleep.
## Step 4: Turn Off Always On Display
Open Settings, tap Lock screen, and then turn off Always On Display. Keeping the clock lit all night consumes a measurable amount of charge on some models.
## Step 5: Turn Off Wi-Fi Scanning and Bluetooth
Open Settings, tap Connections, and turn off Bluetooth if no accessory is paired. Under Wi-Fi advanced settings, turn off the option that keeps the device scanning for networks while Wi-Fi is off.
## Step 6: Install Any Pending Software Update
Open Settings, tap Software update, and then tap Download and install. Battery regressions are frequently corrected in a later firmware release.
## Step 7: Check the Battery in Safe Mode
Restart the phone into Safe mode and leave it overnight. If the drain disappears in Safe mode, a downloaded app is responsible and should be uninstalled while in Safe mode.

query: My Galaxy A54 charges extremely slowly and sometimes stops charging altogether even when it is plugged into the wall.

siis_response.title: Samsung phone or tablet charges slowly or stops charging
siis_response.content:
Smartphone,Tablet Samsung phone or tablet charges slowly or stops charging ( Smartphone,Tablet): # Your Galaxy Device Charges Slowly or Not at All
Slow charging is usually caused by the cable, the port or a setting rather than the battery itself.
## Step 1: Inspect the Cable and the Adapter
Use the cable and adapter that came with the device, or an equivalent rated charger. A damaged cable or a low power adapter will charge the phone far more slowly than expected.
## Step 2: Clean the Charging Port
Look into the charging port with a bright light. Lint pressed into the port prevents the connector from seating fully. Remove any debris gently with a dry, soft brush and never insert anything metal.
## Step 3: Turn On Fast Charging
Open Settings, tap Battery, tap Charging, and then turn on Fast charging. Fast charging is sometimes switched off after a reset or a software update.
## Step 4: Check Battery Protection
Open Settings, tap Battery, tap Charging, and review Battery protection. When protection is set to a maximum of eighty five percent the phone will deliberately stop short of a full charge.
## Step 5: Charge With the Screen Off
Leave the phone alone with the screen off for thirty minutes. Heavy use while charging can consume power as quickly as the adapter supplies it.
## Step 6: Restart the Phone
Restart the phone and then reconnect the charger. A restart clears a stalled charging service.
## Step 7: Run the Battery Diagnostic
Open the Samsung Members app and run the battery test in the diagnostics section. Take the device to a service centre if the test reports a fault.

query: My Galaxy S22 gets very hot while it is charging and the charging slows down or pauses until it cools off.

siis_response.title: Samsung phone or tablet becomes hot while charging
siis_response.content:
Smartphone,Tablet Samsung phone or tablet becomes hot while charging ( Smartphone,Tablet): # Your Galaxy Device Becomes Hot While Charging
The device deliberately slows charging when it becomes warm, in order to protect the battery.
## Step 1: Remove the Case
Take the phone out of its case before charging. A thick case traps heat against the back panel and triggers the protection sooner.
## Step 2: Move the Phone Off Soft Surfaces
Charge the phone on a hard, open surface rather than on a bed, a sofa or a cushion, so that heat can escape.
## Step 3: Stop Using the Phone While It Charges
Avoid gaming, video calls and navigation while the phone is plugged in. These combine a heavy processor load with charging heat.
## Step 4: Turn Off Fast Wireless Charging
Open Settings, tap Battery, tap Charging, and then turn off Fast wireless charging. Wireless charging generates more heat than a cable.
## Step 5: Turn On Power Saving Mode
Open Settings, tap Battery, and then turn on Power saving while the phone charges. Reducing background work lowers the temperature.
## Step 6: Close Background Apps
Open the recent apps view and close everything you are not using, so that no app keeps the processor busy while charging.
## Step 7: Let the Device Cool Before Charging Again
Unplug the phone and leave it for fifteen minutes in a cool place. If it still becomes hot to the touch with nothing running, book a service centre inspection.

query: The battery percentage on my Galaxy Tab jumps around, it will show 30 percent and then suddenly drop to 5 percent and shut down.

siis_response.title: Battery percentage is inaccurate on a Samsung phone or tablet
siis_response.content:
Smartphone,Tablet Battery percentage is inaccurate on a Samsung phone or tablet ( Smartphone,Tablet): # The Battery Percentage Is Inaccurate on Your Galaxy Device
A percentage that jumps or collapses usually means the battery gauge needs recalibrating, or the cell is ageing.
## Step 1: Complete One Full Charge Cycle
Let the device run down until it switches off by itself, then charge it without interruption to one hundred percent. This lets the gauge re-learn the true capacity.
## Step 2: Restart After Charging
Restart the tablet once it reaches one hundred percent, so the reported level is read again from the charging controller.
## Step 3: Turn Off Adaptive Battery
Open Settings, tap Battery, tap Background usage limits, and then turn off Adaptive battery temporarily. Its learned profile can be wrong after a battery change.
## Step 4: Show the Exact Percentage
Open Settings, tap Notifications, tap Advanced settings, and then turn on Show battery percentage, so that you can watch the level accurately.
## Step 5: Install Any Pending Software Update
Open Settings, tap Software update, and then tap Download and install. Gauge corrections often ship as firmware updates.
## Step 6: Run the Battery Diagnostic
Open the Samsung Members app and run the battery status check. A worn cell is reported here.
## Step 7: Back Up and Consider a Battery Replacement
Back up your data, then book a service centre appointment if the diagnostic reports reduced battery life.

query: Ever since the last software update my Galaxy S21 battery only lasts half a day when it used to last all day.

siis_response.title: Battery life is reduced after a software update
siis_response.content:
Smartphone,Tablet Battery life is reduced after a software update ( Smartphone,Tablet): # Battery Life Is Reduced After a Software Update
The first days after an update are unusually heavy because the system rebuilds its indexes and applications reoptimise themselves.
## Step 1: Wait Through the Reindexing Period
Use the phone normally for two or three days. Background reindexing after an update raises consumption temporarily and then settles.
## Step 2: Review Battery Usage by App
Open Settings and tap Battery to see which app consumed the most power since the update. Update that app from the store, because an app built for the previous release can misbehave.
## Step 3: Clear the System Cache Partition
Restart the phone into recovery mode and select the option to wipe the cache partition. This removes stale files left by the previous firmware.
## Step 4: Put Heavy Apps to Sleep
Open Settings, tap Battery, tap Background usage limits, and add the heaviest app to Deep sleeping apps.
## Step 5: Turn On Power Saving Mode
Open Settings, tap Battery, and turn on Power saving to confirm whether the drain is caused by background activity.
## Step 6: Test in Safe Mode
Restart the phone into Safe mode and use it for a few hours. Normal battery life in Safe mode points at a downloaded app, which should be uninstalled while in Safe mode.
## Step 7: Back Up and Reset If the Drain Persists
Back up your data first, then perform a factory reset only if every step above has failed.

query: When I open the camera on my Galaxy S23 the preview is completely black, but the shutter still works and the photo comes out fine.

siis_response.title: Camera preview is black on a Samsung phone or tablet
siis_response.content:
Smartphone,Tablet Camera preview is black on a Samsung phone or tablet ( Smartphone,Tablet): # The Camera Preview Is Black on Your Galaxy Device
A black preview with a working shutter points at the camera app rather than the sensor.
## Step 1: Close and Reopen the Camera
Close the Camera app from the recent apps view and open it again. A preview surface that failed to attach is cleared by restarting the app.
## Step 2: Clear the Camera App Cache
Open Settings, tap Apps, select Camera, tap Storage, and then tap Clear cache. Clearing the cache does not delete your photos.
## Step 3: Check Camera Permissions
Open Settings, tap Apps, select Camera, and tap Permissions. Confirm that the camera permission is allowed.
## Step 4: Check Camera Access
Open Settings, tap Security and privacy, and confirm that Camera access is not switched off for the whole device.
## Step 5: Restart the Phone
Restart the phone to release a camera sensor still held open by another application.
## Step 6: Test in Safe Mode
Restart the phone into Safe mode and open the camera. A working preview in Safe mode means a downloaded app is holding the camera, and that app should be uninstalled while in Safe mode.
## Step 7: Install Any Pending Software Update
Open Settings, tap Software update, and then tap Download and install.

query: Photos from my Galaxy A53 come out blurry and the camera hunts back and forth without ever locking focus.

siis_response.title: Photos are blurry or the camera will not focus
siis_response.content:
Smartphone,Tablet Photos are blurry or the camera will not focus ( Smartphone,Tablet): # Photos Are Blurry on Your Galaxy Device
Focus problems are usually physical, so check the lens before changing any setting.
## Step 1: Clean the Rear Lens
Wipe the rear camera glass with a dry microfibre cloth. A fingerprint or a smear is the single most common cause of soft photos.
## Step 2: Remove the Case or Screen Film
Take off any case, and peel away any protective film that overlaps the camera glass, because it scatters light and confuses autofocus.
## Step 3: Tap to Focus Manually
Open the Camera app and tap the subject on the screen to lock focus, rather than relying on continuous autofocus.
## Step 4: Turn Off Scene Optimiser
Open the Camera app, tap the settings icon, and turn off Scene optimiser. Its automatic adjustments can soften fine detail.
## Step 5: Clear the Camera App Cache
Open Settings, tap Apps, select Camera, tap Storage, and then tap Clear cache.
## Step 6: Reset the Camera Settings
Open the Camera app, tap the settings icon, and select Reset settings to return every option to its default.
## Step 7: Run the Camera Diagnostic
Open the Samsung Members app and run the camera test. Book a service centre appointment if the test reports a hardware fault.

query: My Galaxy S22 Ultra shows a Camera failed message and the app closes by itself every time I try to record a video.

siis_response.title: Camera app closes or reports a failure
siis_response.content:
Smartphone,Tablet Camera app closes or reports a failure ( Smartphone,Tablet): # The Camera App Closes or Reports a Failure
A camera that closes during recording is usually short of resources or blocked by another app.
## Step 1: Force Stop the Camera App
Open Settings, tap Apps, select Camera, and then tap Force stop. Open the camera again afterwards.
## Step 2: Clear the Camera App Cache and Data
Open Settings, tap Apps, select Camera, tap Storage, tap Clear cache, and then tap Clear data. Clearing data returns the camera to its default settings.
## Step 3: Free Up Storage Space
Open Settings, tap Battery and device care, and then tap Storage. Video recording fails when very little free space remains.
## Step 4: Lower the Video Resolution
Open the Camera app, tap the settings icon, and select a lower video resolution and frame rate to reduce the load during recording.
## Step 5: Close Other Apps That Use the Camera
Close any video calling or streaming app from the recent apps view, because two apps cannot hold the camera at the same time.
## Step 6: Restart the Phone
Restart the phone to release the camera service.
## Step 7: Test in Safe Mode
Restart the phone into Safe mode and record a short clip. If recording works, uninstall the suspect app while in Safe mode.

query: The flash on my Galaxy A34 never fires when I take a photo even though I have set it to always on.

siis_response.title: Camera flash does not fire on a Samsung phone or tablet
siis_response.content:
Smartphone,Tablet Camera flash does not fire on a Samsung phone or tablet ( Smartphone,Tablet): # The Camera Flash Does Not Fire
The flash is disabled automatically in several situations, so confirm the mode and the device state first.
## Step 1: Confirm the Flash Mode in the Camera App
Open the Camera app and tap the flash icon until it is set to On rather than Auto or Off.
## Step 2: Check the Torch From Quick Settings
Swipe down from the top of the screen to open the Quick settings panel and tap the Flashlight tile. If the torch does not light either, the problem is the module rather than the camera app.
## Step 3: Turn Off Power Saving Mode
Open Settings, tap Battery, and turn off Power saving. Power saving blocks the flash when the charge is low.
## Step 4: Let the Phone Cool Down
Leave the phone for ten minutes if it feels warm. The flash is disabled while the device is over temperature.
## Step 5: Clear the Camera App Cache
Open Settings, tap Apps, select Camera, tap Storage, and then tap Clear cache.
## Step 6: Restart the Phone
Restart the phone and try the flash again.
## Step 7: Run the Flash Diagnostic
Open the Samsung Members app and run the flash test, then book a service centre appointment if it fails.

query: My Galaxy Tab takes a photo but nothing is saved to the gallery and I get a message saying the storage is full.

siis_response.title: Photos are not saved on a Samsung phone or tablet
siis_response.content:
Smartphone,Tablet Photos are not saved on a Samsung phone or tablet ( Smartphone,Tablet): # Photos Are Not Saved on Your Galaxy Device
A photo that disappears after the shutter has fired was never written to storage.
## Step 1: Check the Available Storage
Open Settings, tap Battery and device care, and then tap Storage. Free at least one gigabyte before taking more photos.
## Step 2: Delete Unneeded Files
In Storage, review the largest categories and delete files you no longer need. Empty the Gallery recycle bin as well, because deleted photos still occupy space for thirty days.
## Step 3: Check the Storage Location
Open the Camera app, tap the settings icon, and confirm the storage location. If a memory card is selected but the card is missing or full, nothing can be written.
## Step 4: Check the Memory Card
Open Settings, tap Battery and device care, tap Storage, and then tap Advanced to inspect the memory card. Unmount and remount a card that reports an error.
## Step 5: Clear the Gallery App Cache
Open Settings, tap Apps, select Gallery, tap Storage, and then tap Clear cache so that the gallery re-reads the folder.
## Step 6: Clear the Camera App Cache
Open Settings, tap Apps, select Camera, tap Storage, and then tap Clear cache.
## Step 7: Restart the Tablet
Restart the tablet so that the media scanner runs again and picks up any photo already on disk.

query: My Galaxy S21 has become really slow, every app takes several seconds to open and scrolling stutters constantly.

siis_response.title: Samsung phone or tablet is slow or laggy
siis_response.content:
Smartphone,Tablet Samsung phone or tablet is slow or laggy ( Smartphone,Tablet): # Your Galaxy Device Is Slow or Laggy
General slowness is almost always storage pressure, background apps or an accumulated cache.
## Step 1: Restart the Phone
Restart the phone first. A restart clears memory held by services that have been running for weeks.
## Step 2: Free Up Storage Space
Open Settings, tap Battery and device care, and then tap Storage. Performance falls sharply once free space drops below ten percent of the total.
## Step 3: Close Background Apps
Open the recent apps view and close everything you are not using, then tap the button that closes all applications.
## Step 4: Put Unused Apps to Sleep
Open Settings, tap Battery, tap Background usage limits, and add rarely used apps to Deep sleeping apps.
## Step 5: Reduce Animations
Open Settings, tap Accessibility, tap Visibility enhancements, and then turn on Reduce animations so that transitions complete immediately.
## Step 6: Install Any Pending Software Update
Open Settings, tap Software update, and then tap Download and install.
## Step 7: Test in Safe Mode
Restart the phone into Safe mode and use it for an hour. If it is fast in Safe mode, uninstall recently added apps while in Safe mode.

query: Apps on my Galaxy A52 keep freezing and closing by themselves, especially when I switch between two of them.

siis_response.title: Apps freeze or close unexpectedly
siis_response.content:
Smartphone,Tablet Apps freeze or close unexpectedly ( Smartphone,Tablet): # Apps Freeze or Close Unexpectedly on Your Galaxy Device
An app that closes on its own has usually run out of memory or is holding a corrupted cache.
## Step 1: Force Stop the Affected App
Open Settings, tap Apps, select the app, and then tap Force stop before opening it again.
## Step 2: Clear the App Cache
Open Settings, tap Apps, select the app, tap Storage, and then tap Clear cache.
## Step 3: Clear the App Data
Open Settings, tap Apps, select the app, tap Storage, and then tap Clear data. Clearing data signs you out and resets the app to its original state.
## Step 4: Update the App
Open the store, find the app, and install any pending update, because an older build can be incompatible with the current firmware.
## Step 5: Turn Off Background Usage Limits for the App
Open Settings, tap Battery, tap Background usage limits, and remove the app from Deep sleeping apps so that it is not killed while in use.
## Step 6: Free Up Storage Space
Open Settings, tap Battery and device care, and then tap Storage, and free at least one gigabyte.
## Step 7: Test in Safe Mode
Restart the phone into Safe mode and use the app. If it is stable, uninstall recently installed apps while in Safe mode.

query: My Galaxy Tab S8 keeps warning me that the storage is full and now it is too slow to even open the settings.

siis_response.title: Storage is full on a Samsung phone or tablet
siis_response.content:
Smartphone,Tablet Storage is full on a Samsung phone or tablet ( Smartphone,Tablet): # Storage Is Full on Your Galaxy Device
The system needs free space to write caches and temporary files, so a full disk slows everything down.
## Step 1: Review What Is Using the Space
Open Settings, tap Battery and device care, and then tap Storage to see the breakdown by category.
## Step 2: Empty the Recycle Bins
Open the Gallery and the My Files app and empty their recycle bins. Deleted items are kept for thirty days and still occupy storage.
## Step 3: Delete Large and Duplicate Files
In Storage, open the large files and duplicate files lists and delete anything you no longer need.
## Step 4: Clear Cached Data for Large Apps
Open Settings, tap Apps, select the largest apps in turn, tap Storage, and then tap Clear cache.
## Step 5: Move Media to a Memory Card or a Computer
Copy photos and videos off the tablet, then delete the originals to reclaim the space.
## Step 6: Uninstall Apps You No Longer Use
Open Settings, tap Apps, select an unused app, and then tap Uninstall.
## Step 7: Restart the Tablet
Restart the tablet once space has been freed so that the system can rebuild its caches.

query: My Galaxy S23 freezes completely for a few seconds and then restarts itself several times a day for no reason.

siis_response.title: Samsung phone or tablet freezes or restarts by itself
siis_response.content:
Smartphone,Tablet Samsung phone or tablet freezes or restarts by itself ( Smartphone,Tablet): # Your Galaxy Device Freezes or Restarts by Itself
Random restarts are caused by a failing app, a full disk, or firmware that needs updating.
## Step 1: Note When the Restarts Happen
Write down which app is open when the device restarts, so the cause can be narrowed down quickly.
## Step 2: Install Any Pending Software Update
Open Settings, tap Software update, and then tap Download and install. Stability fixes are delivered this way.
## Step 3: Free Up Storage Space
Open Settings, tap Battery and device care, and then tap Storage, and free at least one gigabyte.
## Step 4: Clear the Cache of the Suspect App
Open Settings, tap Apps, select the app you noted, tap Storage, and then tap Clear cache.
## Step 5: Charge the Phone Above Twenty Percent
Charge the phone before testing further, because a very low charge can cause the device to shut down under load.
## Step 6: Force Restart the Phone
Press and hold the Side button and the Volume down button together until the phone restarts.
## Step 7: Test in Safe Mode
Restart the phone into Safe mode and use it for a day. If the restarts stop, uninstall the suspect app while in Safe mode.
## Step 8: Back Up and Reset as a Last Resort
Back up your data first, then perform a factory reset only if the restarts continue in Safe mode.

query: After updating my Galaxy S20 the animations are sluggish and the keyboard takes a moment to appear every single time.

siis_response.title: Device is sluggish after a software update
siis_response.content:
Smartphone,Tablet Device is sluggish after a software update ( Smartphone,Tablet): # Your Galaxy Device Is Sluggish After a Software Update
The system reoptimises every installed application after an update, which takes time and storage.
## Step 1: Leave the Phone Charging Overnight
Leave the phone plugged in and idle overnight so that background optimisation can complete.
## Step 2: Clear the System Cache Partition
Restart the phone into recovery mode and select the option to wipe the cache partition, which removes files left by the previous firmware.
## Step 3: Clear the Keyboard App Cache
Open Settings, tap Apps, select the keyboard app, tap Storage, and then tap Clear cache.
## Step 4: Reduce Animations
Open Settings, tap Accessibility, tap Visibility enhancements, and then turn on Reduce animations.
## Step 5: Free Up Storage Space
Open Settings, tap Battery and device care, and then tap Storage. An update consumes free space that the system still needs.
## Step 6: Update Your Apps
Open the store and install pending updates, because apps built for the previous release run more slowly.
## Step 7: Test in Safe Mode
Restart the phone into Safe mode and check whether the keyboard appears immediately. If it does, uninstall the offending app while in Safe mode.
